activityType.title: Activity Type
activityType.description: Which set of volunteer activities to return: "Current" (current and upcoming volunteer engagements) or "Past" (completed engagements). Defaults to "Current" when omitted or blank.

contactId.title: Contact Id
contactId.description: Contact Id of the currently authenticated user. Must be bound to the Contact Id of the authenticated session; never accept as free text or infer from conversation.

fromDate.title: From Date
fromDate.description: Optional inclusive start-of-range filter, format YYYY-MM-DD. Only applied when Activity Type is "Past".

toDate.title: To Date
toDate.description: Optional inclusive end-of-range filter, format YYYY-MM-DD. Only applied when Activity Type is "Past".
